strategy.thesis: Early-stage (seed to IPO) VC arm of internet holding company Info Edge, co-sponsored by Temasek; invests in tech-enabled startups off the parent balance sheet and via dedicated funds.

summary.en: Info Edge Ventures is the early-stage venture arm of Info Edge (India) Ltd, the internet holding company behind Naukri.com, 99acres, Jeevansathi and Shiksha. Co-sponsored by Temasek, it invests in tech-enabled startups from seed to IPO via balance-sheet investments and dedicated funds. Info Edge is widely cited as India's most successful corporate venture investor on the back of early bets on Zomato and Policybazaar.

summary.en: Wipro Ventures is the Silicon Valley-based strategic investment arm of Indian IT services giant Wipro Limited, established in 2015. summary.en: JioGenNext is the corporate startup accelerator of Reliance Industries / Jio Platforms, launched in 2013 and based in Navi Mumbai. It runs an equity-free, no-fee program (now continuous rather than cohort-based) that has supported 170+ tech startups, with its Market Access Program connecting founders into the Reliance ecosystem. Reliance has separately operated GenNext Ventures (taking up to 15% stakes) and the Reliance Jio Digital India Startup Fund.

summary.en: Brand Capital International is the strategic investment (media-for-equity) arm of Bennett Coleman & Co. Ltd, India's Times Group, founded in 2005. It is one of India's most active corporate venture investors, having deployed USD 4bn+ of media value into 900+ companies across EdTech, FinTech, HealthTech, retail and consumer sectors in exchange for equity. It is a technology-adjacent / internet-media CVC rather than a pure cash investor.
